messages.subject: Now Available, LD Scores for all 6 Pan-UKBB Populations (AFR, EUR, AMR, EAS, CSA, MID)
parts:
Hi GenomicSEM team and users! 

I have prepared the UKBB LD scores for use directly in GenomicSEM (primarily LDSC) and tested them getting very similar results to the existing 1kg files. The files for each ancestry group have already been properly formatted, just set ld and wld accordingly. Feel free to use these files for your analyses, but please cite the appropriate sources. 
Download available on Zenodo here: https://zenodo.org/records/24426843

-James (Jimmy) Hart
